value.rationale: Four-cell periodic meshes are the smallest cyclic setting showing consistent-mass sign loss. The exact threshold replaces the conservative sufficient Stieltjes time-step bound, is valid for any grading, and identifies four direction-sensitive sign mechanisms invisible in the alternating special case. At lengths (1,2,3,4), positivity holds at t=5/2 below max(h_i^2)/6=8/3, and at t=1 P31<0<P13. This is a complete natural parameter classification, not a table-only computation.
